package app_test

// This file is overlaid as _test.go on the pinned BSD source by scripts/qase90.py.
// It reuses its real API import, PostgreSQL, TLS object store and scheduler seam.
import (
	"bufio"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"log/slog"
	"net"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/fin-assist/go-worker"
	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"

	"github.com/fin-assist/bank-statement-data/internal/app"
	"github.com/fin-assist/bank-statement-data/internal/app/apitest"
	"github.com/fin-assist/bank-statement-data/internal/config"
)

func TestAPIQase90Fixture(t *testing.T) {
	fmt.Println("Q90_STAGE bsd:seed")
	seed := apitest.StartWith(t, app.Options{Now: calculationNow})
	operationsAPIImport(t, seed, calculationRuleOFX())
	var id, taxi string
	if err := seed.App.DB.Primary().QueryRow(t.Context(), `SELECT id::text FROM regular_payment WHERE user_id=$1 AND description='Cloud'`, apiUser).Scan(&id); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := seed.App.DB.Primary().QueryRow(t.Context(), `SELECT id::text FROM regular_payment WHERE user_id=$1 AND description='Taxi'`, apiUser).Scan(&taxi); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cfg := seed.App.Cfg
	seed.Stop()
	cfg.Service, cfg.Env, cfg.Auth.Mode = "bank-statement-data", config.EnvStage, config.AuthVerify
	cfg.Peers = map[string]string{"analytics": os.Getenv("Q90_ANALYTICS"), "user": os.Getenv("Q90_USER")}
	cfg.Auth.Identity = config.IdentityConfig{UserIssuer: os.Getenv("Q90_USER_ISSUER"), UserAudience: os.Getenv("Q90_USER_AUDIENCE"), Stage: config.StageIdentity{Issuer: os.Getenv("Q90_STAGE_ISSUER"), SigningKeyFile: os.Getenv("Q90_KEY"), PublicKeysFile: os.Getenv("Q90_JWKS")}}
	fmt.Println("Q90_STAGE bsd:verified-assembly")
	clock := &tickClock{ticks: make(chan time.Time, 1)}
	a, err := app.New(t.Context(), cfg, slog.New(slog.DiscardHandler), prometheus.NewRegistry(), app.Options{ObjectClient: seed.Objects.Server.Client(), RecalculationClock: clock})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(a.Close)
	lis, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	go func() { _ = a.GRPC.Serve(lis) }()
	a.GRPC.SetServing(true)
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		a.GRPC.Shutdown(ctx, 0)
		_ = lis.Close()
	})
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		done <- worker.Run(ctx, worker.Options{Logger: slog.New(slog.DiscardHandler), Clock: worker.SystemClock{}}, a.Jobs...)
	}()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		cancel()
		if err := <-done; err != nil && !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	env := &apitest.Env{App: a}
	settle := func() {
		clock.ticks <- time.Now()
		eventuallyMetrics(t, func() bool {
			var n int
			err := a.DB.Primary().QueryRow(t.Context(), `SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM recalc_queue WHERE user_id=$1)+(SELECT count(*) FROM outbox_events)`, apiUser).Scan(&n)
			return err == nil && n == 0
		})
	}
	fmt.Println("Q90_STAGE bsd:initial-calculation")
	settle()
	reply := func(v any) {
		raw, err := json.Marshal(v)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		fmt.Println("QASE90 " + string(raw))
	}
	reply(map[string]string{"Address": lis.Addr().String(), "ID": id, "Taxi": taxi, "User": apiUser})
	scan := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)
	for scan.Scan() {
		switch scan.Text() {
		case "snapshot":
			reply(dismissalStoredState(t, env, id))
		case "retry":
			awaitMarkerRetry(t, env, id, time.Now())
			reply(map[string]bool{"OK": true})
		case "ack":
			awaitMarkerACK(t, env, id)
			reply(map[string]bool{"OK": true})
		case "calculate":
			settle()
			reply(map[string]bool{"OK": true})
		case "stop":
			return
		default:
			t.Fatal("unknown Q90 command")
		}
	}
	if err := scan.Err(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
